items.summary: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi has moved the Supreme Court challenging the manner in which the Election Commission is conducting the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. Advocate Nizamuddin Pasha mentioned the plea on Wednesday before a CJI Surya Kant-led bench, seeking that it be heard alongside the connected SIR matters listed for Thursday, October 15. The CJI said he would check and list it with the similar cases. The petition joins the Oct-12 writ plea by Rahul Gandhi and 10 INDIA bloc leaders and other pending SIR challenges; specific grounds and reliefs were not detailed at mentioning.
items.title: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi moves Supreme Court challenging SIR of electoral rolls
